items.title: Ametria Dock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 4, 2019
items.q: And he got the part of Simba on Broadway.

ctx.x: Which is wonderful and it also makes things a little harder.

It does. I mean we’re talking a seventh grader right now so we’re not even in high school but she’s getting lots of opportunities so far. It’s funny her birthday is the same day as Janelle Monae and so Janelle always, she’s like Aunt Janelle, so she’s always talking to her and encouraging her, and motivating her, but she has the same, Janelle is doing movies and she’s doing albums and touring and everything. And Janelle says I see myself in Kayla. It’s the same. So it’s so funny. Another story, I have another…
Much like the word “fruition,” that you’ve used for your business.
